create_switch_transformers_config: create a SwitchTransformersConfig instance with default hyperparameters for the Switch Transformer model
configure_sparse_encoder_layers: configure SwitchTransformersConfig num_sparse_encoder_layers to set sparse MoE layer placement in the encoder
configure_sparse_decoder_layers: configure SwitchTransformersConfig num_sparse_decoder_layers to set sparse MoE layer placement in the decoder
customize_router_settings: customize SwitchTransformersConfig router_bias, router_dtype, and router_jitter_noise for mixture-of-experts routing
load_from_checkpoint: load a SwitchTransformersConfig from the google/switch-base-8 pretrained checkpoint
